verdict.rationale: Cekura is a testing and observability platform, so OTLP trace ingestion and export is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows its own channels: a proprietary send-calls POST endpoint that stores transcripts as CallLogs, LiveKit tracing through the Cekura SDK, and Retell API polling. Nothing in the pack mentions OpenTelemetry or OTLP, either inbound or outbound.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format
